camera_height_m: about 2.45, at her own eye height near the lamp line — the last set-up in the episode allowed to sit this high
angle: straight down, along the axis of her own body
start_frame: Looking straight down the length of her own body from her eye height: her front running away steeply down the middle of the image, her boots small and absurdly distant at the bottom of the frame on the flagstones by the glass table.
end_frame: The same frame held through the line and the wave: the boots — the same black ankle-strap boots that kicked once and vanished under the hedge — still tiny and far below, and no nearer at the end than at the start.
constraint_honoured: 'Played absolutely straight — the one piece of pure comedy in the dream half' — no move anywhere near the joke, which is entirely optical.
movement_note: The second and last rationed 24 mm shot. A camera move along this axis would unwind the near-to-far stretch that is the whole gag. LN-ep01-017 (5.8 s) lands whole in 7.0 s.
